title: Materialize share credentials atomically without symlink or permission races
description:
## Finding

Share state uses `create_dir_all`, then ordinary `write` on `statedir.join(dest)`, following existing symlinks and overwriting files. Owner-only permission hardening is best-effort and ignored. Directory ownership/mode, path containment, existing inode type/link count, and atomic replacement are not verified. Credential files remain after stop/failure.

## Evidence

* `crates/thegn-svc/src/share/mod.rs:567-584` creates and writes paths directly.
* `SharePlanFile.dest` is a string joined without validation.
* `restrict_to_owner` failure is discarded despite documentation promising files at 0600 and directories at 0700.
* Start materializes before spawn but failure/stop has no credential cleanup transaction.

## Impact

A pre-existing same-user or attacker-controlled state path can redirect secret/config writes to another file; insecure permissions can disclose FRP tokens; stale credentials persist beyond the share lifecycle.

## Acceptance criteria

* Create/verify the state root and each parent with strict owner, mode, type, and no-symlink invariants.
* Reject absolute, parent, separator, control, and overlong destination components.
* Use same-directory exclusive temporary files, no-follow opens, explicit 0600, fsync/rename, and post-open inode verification.
* Treat every hardening failure as fatal before spawn.
* Tie credentials to an owned share generation and remove them on failure/stop with crash-safe stale cleanup.
* Add symlink/hardlink/FIFO/device, replacement race, permission failure, colliding state, partial write, crash, and concurrent start tests.

## Dependencies

Blocked by <issue id="db32c360-c0df-469a-8ed6-1a6666090256" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-327/use-collision-resistant-canonical-identity-for-per-share-state">THE-327</issue> for canonical state identity. Related to <issue id="eeadf0e9-6877-4193-bc30-d8b09a04c750" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-222/secure-cross-host-merge-bundle-tempfiles-against-symlink-clobbering">THE-222</issue>, <issue id="770c363e-8f51-48bd-9d09-63664a9d8e6f" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-224/harden-and-lifecycle-local-sandbox-secret-environment-files">THE-224</issue>, and <issue id="de742eb6-71b3-4215-98cc-c68fa7c3d6db" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-325/credential-isolate-public-share-clients-and-remove-secrets-from-argv">THE-325</issue>.
